rawFindings.title: Karma middleware now uses a stale client config object after config replacement
rawFindings.explanation: Injecting `config.client` when the middleware is created means `/debug.html` serializes that original object forever. The previous implementation fetched `config.client` from the injector on each request, so if the runtime config is replaced between requests the generated debug page reflected the new config.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore per-request lookup by injecting `injector` (or `config`) and reading `config.client`, `config.customContextFile`, and `config.customDebugFile` inside the returned request handler.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Start with `config.client = {foo: 'bar'}`, request `/__karma__/debug.html`, then replace `config.client` with `{foo: 'baz'}` and request `/__karma__/debug.html` again; the new code still emits `window.__karma__.config = {"foo":"bar"};` instead of `{"foo":"baz"}`.
